titulo: Me taking just one more photo
caption:
Me taking just one more photo

Me taking just one more photo.

The tenth photo is rarely better than the third. Pick one, put the phone away, and enjoy the person you just photographed.

Send it to the friend who says one more and means ten.

alt: A short film with no voice, with music. A dark room. Two small block figures with white eyes, an amber one on the left and a light blue one on the right, with a small counter between them reading #1. The amber one pulses and a white star flashes between them like a camera flash, and the blue one blinks at every flash. The counter climbs to #2, #3, #4, #5 while the blue one gets sleepier, tilts, and finally falls asleep standing up. The amber one narrows its eyes at the camera. The text stays: me taking just one more photo.
